title: 緣
coverageBoundaryNote: Allowed ceiling locked to formal L001-L465 plus provisional 案、反、而、且、故 and current 緣: 475 unique Han.
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved L477 handoff. 緣 ㄩㄢˊ. S01 因為的為 ㄨㄟˋ; all 緣 occurrences ㄩㄢˊ; 故事的事 uses Taiwan ㄕˋ. S01 keeps family safely behind a guardrail; S02 shows layout ratio without readable text; S03/S05 require fixed Xiaoguang/Xiaoyue identities; S05 is an unplanned travel encounter.

sentences.text: 因為大雨的緣故，河水很急。
sentences.spokenText: 因為大雨的緣故河水很急
sentences.imageNotes: 大雨中的河道，水量明顯增加，水面有急流、浪花，岸邊草木被雨打濕。主角女孩和主角爸爸站在有屋頂、護欄的安全觀景處望著河水。人物不靠近水邊、不下水。雨和急流同時可見，不能只畫平靜晴天河景，也不災難化。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 polished modern children's picture-book illustration matching the full approved L058 STYLE ONLY set and refined L115/L118/L119/L128 examples: warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, softly layered gouache texture, detailed but clean Taiwan environment, stable preschool proportions, gentle expressive faces, bright warm palette, phone-readable composition and safe margins. Use recurring family identity anchors L154-S01, L162-S04 and L163-S02 whenever protagonist family appears. Protagonist girl: preschool age, short dark bob, small pink hairclip, pink cardigan, cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. Fixed father: short dark hair, blue overshirt and cream shirt. Fixed mother: chin-length dark hair, cream cardigan and practical blue clothing. Named cast must follow their dedicated reference images. Do not copy any L058 person. No readable text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, captions or speech bubbles. During heavy rain, show a visibly swollen fast-moving river with clear current streaks, small rapids and splashes; wet riverside plants bend under rain. The recurring protagonist girl and fixed father watch safely from a roofed observation shelter behind a sturdy guardrail, well away from the water. Rain and fast current must both be obvious. Calm and educational, not a disaster; nobody enters or approaches the river.

sentences.text: 這本故事書字大，而且圖多。
sentences.spokenText: 這本故事書字大而且圖多
sentences.imageNotes: 家中主角女孩與主角媽媽一起翻看大開本故事書。攤開頁面以大幅插圖為主，只留少量大字的文字區，字大、圖多同時可見。文字不要求辨讀，不指定可讀漢字、書名或內容；不要密密麻麻小字，也不要把頁面全部畫成沒有字區。老師批准的是版面比例，不是清楚文字／數字入圖例外。

sentences.text: 小光很熱心，而且人緣很好。
sentences.spokenText: 小光很熱心而且人緣很好
sentences.imageNotes: 教室裡，固定小光幫 generic 同學撿掉落文具，對方開心向他道謝；旁邊主角女孩和固定小月笑著招手，等小光一起玩。用主動幫忙及同學喜歡找他表現熱心、人緣好，不畫成集體鼓掌或小光受獎。小光用 public/assets/reference/lesson-cast/xiaoguang.webp；小月用 public/assets/reference/lesson-cast/xiaoyue.webp；兩個 named cast 都不能畫成 generic 或主角女孩。

In a warm classroom, fixed cast Xiaoguang helps one generic classmate pick up dropped pencils and erasers; the classmate smiles gratefully. Nearby, the recurring protagonist girl and fixed cast Xiaoyue smile and wave for Xiaoguang to join their play. Xiaoguang must match xiaoguang.webp: round glasses, tidy short black hair, white short-sleeve shirt, deep navy knit vest, khaki shorts, white socks, brown shoes, dark green backpack if present. Xiaoyue must match xiaoyue.webp: long softly curled deep chestnut hair, moon hairclip, lavender cardigan, pale cream top, teal pleated skirt, white socks, purple shoes. Show helpfulness and friendship naturally; no award, stage or group applause.

sentences.text: 圖案在反面，把紙翻過來。
sentences.spokenText: 圖案在反面把紙翻過來
sentences.imageNotes: 純物件近景，不出現人物、手或身體。暖色木桌上只有一張長方形紙，大部分平放的正面完全空白；右側近角依老師提供的實物參考平順掀起，形成同一張紙連續彎折的三角形反面。只有翻起的三角形反面帶少量無意義的柔和幾何色塊，大片平面不帶圖案。紙張厚度、折線、邊角及陰影須一致，不得出現第二張紙、額外夾層或人物。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 polished modern children’s picture-book illustration with warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, softly layered gouache texture and a clean phone-readable silhouette. Object-only close-up: no people, no hands, no arms, no characters, no faces, no animals. On a warm wooden tabletop, show one rectangular sheet lying mostly flat while its near-right corner is smoothly lifted and folded back as one curved triangular flap, following the teacher-provided physical reference. The large flat main area is completely blank warm white. Only the lifted triangular reverse face has a sparse abstract pattern of pastel dots, circles, triangles and soft blocks, correctly foreshortened. Make the flat sheet and flap visibly one continuous piece with consistent paper thickness, one clean diagonal turning edge and no extra layer. No readable text, letters, numbers, grid, labels, logos, watermark, caption or speech bubble.

sentences.imageNotes: 外地海邊遊玩步道，主角女孩和主角爸爸散步，意外遇見與家人出遊的小月。兩個女孩驚喜認出彼此、揮手打招呼，雙方家長微笑停步。不是約好同行，也不是天天在教室見面。小月依 fixed reference；陪同她的是小月家長，未建固定參考時用明確區別主角父母的 generic 家長，不把主角媽媽畫成小月媽媽。
